item.title: Israel is 'dismantling Palestinian life' says Israeli human rights group
item.description: One of the country's leading human rights organizations says Israel is dismantling all aspects of Palestinian life at a breakneck rate. The group has extensively documented what it says are the mechanisms Israel has used to "ethnically cleanse" the West Bank of Palestinians.

item.title: 10 years after taking a knee, Colin Kaepernick is still waging a 'Perilous Fight'
item.description: The former 49ers quarterback created an uproar in 2016 when took a knee during the national anthem to protest police brutality. In The Perilous Fight he explains why he still wants to play football.

item.description: In two board resolutions made public Monday, the arts institution says it is in a dire financial and physical state — and that only President Trump can "rescue" it.

item.title: The producer of Fleabag and Baby Reindeer's tip for finding a hit? Don't look for one

item.title: This city led the way on reparations for Black people. Trump is trying to stop it
item.description: Evanston, Ill., became the first U.S. city to compensate Black people for historical discrimination. The Justice Department is trying to kill its program before other cities follow suit.

item.title: The powerful millionaires hiding in plain sight
item.description: They own car dealerships, law firms, dental practices, and restaurant chains. Collectively, these overlooked business owners hold far more wealth than the Forbes 400 — and wield considerable political power.

item.description: China's Foreign Ministry called the Anthropic CEO's warning about the dangers of Chinese-developed AI "fearmongering," as the Chinese and U.S. leaders prepare to meet in Washington later this month.

item.title: New Carlo Rovelli book challenges science's understanding of reality and the universe
item.description: In his latest book, the world-renowned physicist draws on science and philosophy to explore the notion that the university and reality are fully knowable.

item.title: NPR looked for ChatGPT's new crisis feature. It's hard to find
item.description: Earlier this year, OpenAI launched a feature on ChatGPT meant to help people at risk of suicide connect with someone they trust for support. But its setup may prove challenging to someone in crisis.
